actions.reason: C0001 has coherent multi-modal identity evidence (strong inflammatory/immune RNA program with BAP1 mutation enrichment and 9p/CDKN2A loss), moderate internal resampling stability (ARI 0.78), and no technical confounder explaining the molecular signal; the CJ site association does not plausibly account for the RNA/WXS/CNV phenotype. Weak per-modality silhouettes and high PAC leave residual boundary uncertainty, but no available evidence request remains and no better-supported structural revision is indicated, so retention for downstream validation is defensible.

C0002 shows a coherent immune-low, proliferation-low profile with PBRM1/VHL enrichment and a distinctive CNV landscape, and no technical or site confounder is detected. Internal resampling stability is low (ARI 0.33, PAC 0.77), so boundaries are not sharply defined, but no positive structural evidence supports splitting or merging this exact set and no available request remains; retaining it as a discovery-stage candidate is defensible.

C0003 is defined by a strong, coherent mutation signal (PBRM1-absent, VHL/BAP1-depleted, TP53-enriched) with no technical or site confounder detected. RNA and CNV support is weak and per-modality silhouettes are near zero, leaving boundary uncertainty, but no positive structural evidence supports splitting or merging this exact set and no available request remains; retention for downstream validation is defensible.
